author: nemi
text: There's a cup! See, I told you this was worth investigating. Oh, those are pencils. I've come to the stationery cupboard for pudding, and somehow I'm still looking for a spoon. Please don't tell the sandwich; it'll think it's won. Come on, six gets us to assembly before I start checking glue sticks for ingredients.
